text.title: Retro Format Rotation Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable signals from the rotation artefact (committed history, last-3 set, distribution, fatigue, stale-format signals, recorded counts, refresh trend) to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml.

decision-tree.root-question: Is there a committed 3-retro history with counts, and does the candidate next_format respect the no-repeat rule, the async pool, the stale detector and the fatigue lookback?

branch.when: fewer than 3 committed retro instances for this team OR first-ever retro OR one-shot post-incident retro

conclusion.verdict: SKIP: no rotation until three committed instances exist

branch.when: last_3_formats does not match the three most recent committed instances

conclusion.verdict: BLOCK: rebuild the history from the committed instances, newest first

branch.when: last two scheduled retros have no action-item / participant / silent-participant counts recorded

conclusion.verdict: BLOCK: backfill the counts; the stale detector is blind without them

branch.when: two consecutive rotations to non-stale formats raised neither action-item count nor contributing-participant count

conclusion.verdict: SUSPEND rotation: record that fatigue is not a format problem; route to morale pulse / burnout tripwires

branch.when: distribution == async AND next_format in {mad-sad-glad, lean-coffee} OR scheduled without anonymous asynchronous input

conclusion.verdict: BLOCK: rotate within the async-capable pool with a timezone-spanning window

branch.when: next_format in last_3_formats AND no recorded async-pool exception

conclusion.verdict: BLOCK: pick a format not used in the last three retros

branch.when: candidate format appears twice in last 3 OR its action-item count fell > 50% between its last two uses OR its last outcome review shows 2+ silent participants

conclusion.verdict: BLOCK: format is stale for this team; exclude it and name the triggering signal in the rationale

branch.when: fatigue_signal == fatigued AND candidate format used by this team within the last 12 months

conclusion.verdict: BLOCK: pick a format unused for 12 months or never used; state its last-used date

branch.when: rationale < 20 chars OR does not name the three previous formats, distribution, fatigue signal and the deciding tie-breaker

conclusion.verdict: BLOCK: write the rationale with history, team state and the tie-breaker that decided
APPROVE: schedule the next retro with the chosen format; record counts at its outcome review

text.example: Team platform; committed history [mad-sad-glad, 4ls, sailboat] with counts (5/6/4 actions, 0 silent); distribution shifted to async after Carol moved to PT; fatigue rotating → anonymous-async (not in last 3, in async pool, not stale); rationale names all three previous formats and the async tie-breaker → APPROVE.
